title: Pytest-benchmark endpoint latency regression
what: test_search_query mean latency regression (%) or ms increase on PR vs base
required_disclosures: 40 benchmark rounds with spread (s.d. or IQR)

reader_questions.question: Which endpoint regressed and by how much?
reader_questions.expected: test_search_query regressed by +42.0% (+7.8 ms, to 26.5 ms mean).

reader_questions.question: Is the regression clearly outside benchmark noise, and what about the other five endpoints?
reader_questions.expected: Yes, test_search_query shifts well beyond ±1 s.d.; all five other endpoints overlap within ±1 s.d.

reader_questions.question: Did any other endpoint show a meaningful speedup or slowdown?
reader_questions.expected: No; the remaining five endpoints stayed within roughly ±2% of base.
